storyline.real: Verstappen crashes out on lap 1 after contact with Hamilton; Leclerc leads from the standing restart on one stop, and Hamilton, carrying a 10-second penalty, catches him and passes him at Copse on lap 50 to win by 3.871 s.
storyline.headline: Leclerc holds Hamilton off to win at Silverstone

eras.briefing: Silverstone, 2021. Verstappen is out on lap 1 after touching wheels with Hamilton at Copse, and the race is red-flagged. You run Leclerc, who leads from the standing restart with Hamilton right behind. Hamilton has a 10-second penalty to serve at his stop. Hold him off.
